## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Porto, Portugal. It starts at Rua Dom João de Castro 210.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ever wondered what it's like to sit high amongst the tree tops? Well, wonder no more and roam through the canopy of Serralves Park! You'll see Portuguese flora, like stone pine and cork oak, as well as exotic species such as liquidambars and giant sequoias.
>
> Down on the ground, take time to explore the park's 18 hectares and some 8,000 specimens of plants representing close to 230 species. Sculptures from the Serralves Foundation's collection dot the park too, so keep an eye out.
